units: metres; Blender Z up, character faces -Y; FBX -Z forward, Y up

clips.name: GetUp_FromBack_v03
clips.start_pose: supine, face up, head toward local +Y, feet -Y; butt and hood on the floor (pelvis pitch -67), head resting on the hood, arms along the sides, palms down
clips.ragdoll_blend: first frame = neutral lying pose held 5 frames; blend ragdoll->clip over 0.35 s (Neck/Head 0.5 s); the first motion after the hold is slow

stable.meaning: from here to the end the character is upright over the root with feet down (standing capsule may turn on)

beats_0based.what: HOLD supine start (ragdoll blend target). Head tipped back on the hood, turned left; palms down beside the hips; legs relaxed, toes up and out.
GROGGY HEAD LIFT: neck flexes, head peels off the floor and looks at the feet ("huh?"), slow with a small lateral bobble; left knee twitches up a little.
ANTICIPATION: head drops back a touch, hands leave the floor (IK->FK), shoulders load.

SIT-UP SNAP: pelvis -90 -> -8, spine curls to 45 (overshoot over the legs), arms thrown forward toward the feet; heels pop up 5-6 cm (counterweight) and slap down at f22; head lags then whips forward.
SETTLE to a slumped sit; hands land on the thighs (IK on the thigh tops).
DIZZY CIRCLE: neck/head/upper spine trace one slow circle (~2 Hz, 14 deg neck, 6 deg spine with phase lag); arms ride limp on the thighs.
BRR SHAKE: head twist +-30 deg at 5 Hz decaying, neck side +-8, spine twist counter-shakes with lag, shoulders shrug up during the shake ("shaking off the stars").
GATHER: feet slide to y=-0.27 (soles flatten, knees up), hands plant behind the hips (fingers out/back), torso leans back onto the arms (pelvis -32).
ROCK-UP: push off the hands, rock forward over the feet into a deep squat (hips to y=-0.17, z=0.33, pelvis +38), arms swing forward for momentum, head lags.
RISE to standing too fast (hips to y=-0.22, z=0.80); head comes up last.

HEAD-RUSH STAGGER BACK: body keeps tipping back (spine -10, head thrown back), arms windmill (one circle per ~9 frames, keep < 25 deg per half frame), RIGHT foot steps back to its Idle spot (y 0), hips drop to absorb.
RECOVER: LEFT foot steps back to Idle, hips return to (0,0), small head wobble, arms drop, settle exactly into Idle frame 1. Stable ~f71 (0.85) or earlier once upright.

clips.name: GetUp_FromBelly_v03
clips.start_pose: prone, face down, head toward local -Y, feet +Y; right cheek on the floor, head turned left, hands beside the chest ready to push, thighs and shoe tops on the floor
clips.ragdoll_blend: first frame = neutral lying pose held 6 frames; blend ragdoll->clip over 0.35 s (Neck/Head 0.5 s); the first motion after the hold is slow

stable.meaning: from here to the end the character is upright over the root with feet down (standing capsule may turn on)

beats_0based.what: HOLD prone start: head turned left, right cheek on the floor; hands beside the chest (push-up hands), elbows up/back; legs straight, shoe tops on the floor.
PUSH 1 (noodle arms): chest rises, arms tremble (8-10 Hz torso bob +-1 cm drives the IK elbows), head hangs, face still near the floor.
ARMS BUCKLE: chest flops back down halfway (3 frames), head nearly bonks.
PUSH 2 + PUSH BACK: determined push, hips shift back over the knees (hips 0 -> y +0.30), knees slide under -> all fours (knees ~y +0.30, hands stay at y -0.15).
ALL-FOURS DIZZY: head hangs low, one slow circle, then a whole-body WET-DOG SHAKE (head leads, spine side/twist follows with lag, ~5 Hz, 2.5 cycles).
KNEEL UP + HALF-KNEEL: hands push off, torso swings up to kneeling; RIGHT foot swings forward to its Idle spot (y ~0); both hands go onto the right knee (handOnKnee).
STAND: push on the knee, hips forward/up to (0,0,~0.8); LEFT foot swings forward from behind to its Idle spot; head comes up last.
FORWARD TEETER (in place, no steps): head rush tips him forward onto the toes (heels up ~4 cm), arms windmill, then he rocks back onto the heels (toes up slightly).
SETTLE into Idle frame 1. Stable ~f63 (0.75).
